q: Data quality is best described as:
options: The absence of all missing values
why: Fitness-for-purpose depends on intended use and known limitations.

q: A blank value is replaced with zero. The main concern is:
options: Zero and missing have different meanings
why: Zero is an observed numeric value; missing is not the same state.

q: A patient ID repeats in an encounter-level table. What should happen first?
options: Check the declared grain and encounter key
why: One patient can legitimately have multiple encounters.

options: Every encounter patient key exists in the patient table
why: A foreign key should match a valid parent record.

q: An extreme value outside an exploratory range should be:
options: Flagged and investigated against source and context
why: Extreme observations may be valid; investigate before changing them.
